title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) in Jenkins Plug-in for ServiceNow DevOps
description: A cross-site request forgery vulnerability exists in versions of the Jenkins Plug-in for ServiceNow DevOps prior to 1.38.1 that, if exploited successfully, could cause the unwanted exposure of sensitive information. To address this issue, apply the 1.38.1 version of the Jenkins plug-in for ServiceNow DevOps on your Jenkins server.  No changes are required on your instances of the Now Platform.

title: Missing Authorization in Jenkins plug-in for ServiceNow DevOps
